column1: # Pro subscriptions granted at container boot, one account per row. Whitespace-separated:
#   master_pkey   64-char hex Ed25519 *master Pro* public key of the recipient. This is a public
#                 identifier derived from the account seed and cannot be reversed to it, so it is safe
#                 to commit. It is NOT the 05… Session ID.
#   provider      stf | google_play | app_store. The first is a real out-of-band grant;
#                 the other two mint a payment the store never saw, for exercising the per-provider
#                 code paths. All three require nothing from Apple/Google under provider_dry_run.
#   duration_s    optional; overrides the plan's nominal length. Useful for expiry tests.
# Blank lines and #-comments are ignored. A row is SKIPPED if the account already has an unexpired
# subscription, so restarting the stack does not stack up duplicate payments.
